body.br:
1. An apparatus, comprising:
a guide wire configured to be positioned within a blood vessel of a patient, wherein the guide wire comprises a proximal portion and a distal portion;
a mounting structure positioned at the distal portion of the guide wire, wherein the mounting structure comprises a plurality of material layers defining a first section of the mounting structure and a second section of the mounting structure, wherein the plurality of material layers is formed on top of one another such that the second section is lower than the first section; and
a sensor comprising a body portion and an active portion configured to obtain data related to the blood vessel, wherein the body portion is mounted in the first section of the mounting structure on a first surface of the plurality of material layers, wherein the active portion is cantilevered over the second section of the mounting structure.
2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the second section of the mounting structure comprises a second surface of the plurality of material layers that is lower than the first surface of the plurality of material layers.
3. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the sensor comprises a pressure sensor.
4. The apparatus of claim 3, wherein the active portion comprises a pressure-sensing diaphragm.
5. The apparatus of claim 4, wherein the pressure-sensing diaphragm is positioned face up.
6. The apparatus of claim 4, wherein the pressure-sensing diaphragm is positioned face down.
7. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the second section of the mounting structure is distal of the first section of the mounting structure.
8. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the plurality of material layers comprises a first material layer having a first thickness and a second material layer having a different, second thickness.
9. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the plurality of material layers comprises a first material layer and a second material layer having a same thickness.
10. The apparatus of The apparatus of wherein two or more of the plurality of material layers comprise a different width in a direction perpendicular to a longitudinal axis of the mounting structure,
wherein the different widths of the plurality of material layers together define a size and a shape of an outer profile of the mounting structure.
11. The apparatus of claim 10, wherein the outer profile of the mounting structure comprises a rounded or arcuate shape.
12. The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising:a connector positioned at the proximal portion of the guide wire; and
a conductor comprising a proximal section and a distal section, wherein the distal section of the conductor is coupled to the sensor and the proximal section of the conductor is coupled to the connector.
13. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the guide wire comprises an outer diameter between 0.0007" and 0.118".
